workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Importing an envd file with `asset_ref` can disconnect the reverse WebSocket on a slow uplink
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(envd): preserve shared carrier progress during slow transfers. Target files: crates/a13n-envd/src/stdio.rs, crates/a13n-envd/src/transfer.rs, crates/a13n-envd/src/websocket.rs. A reverse-WebSocket file upload over a slow upstream could stop the shared carrier from reading Ping/Pong, transfer CREDIT and Session controls while an outbound send waited. Even after separating reads from writes, bulk bytes already flushed into TCP could bury heartbeats. This change keeps the reader active and bounds outstandi... (Ref: https://github.com/converge-ai-labs/agent-foundation/pull/1615)
